title: Population Share of Strata with Positive CATE under a Soft Margin
banked_reason: D0.5.G tier=incremental < floor=field; paper_score_ceiling 6.2 < 7.4; exact growing-alphabet frontier and pilot-local factorial estimator remain open.
gap_reasons: The note proves unconditional sample-based upper bounds and matching fixed-alphabet cube-root orders, while its growing-alphabet converse matches only up to an exp{-C sqrt(log d)} factor.
It therefore does not establish the advertised exact uniform n,d frontier or the proposed pilot-local factorial estimator, although the framing accurately leaves both open.

The projected paper score is further constrained by the absence of the proposed 65 Trial analysis or other reproducible evidence that the strict 50t margin is scientifically credible for a prespecified partition.

proof_attempt_summary: Discovery proved sample-based upper bounds and matching fixed-alphabet cube-root orders, then strengthened the growing-alphabet converse through fixed- and growing-degree moment constructions. The general frontier remains separated by an exp{C sqrt(log d)} factor, and the proposed pilot-local factorial estimator and 65 Trial analysis were not delivered. The final D0.5 math and decision referees both passed with zero findings, but the graded novelty tier was incremental below the required field floor.
tldr: The target is the population share of categorical strata with positive conditional average treatment effect. Under the strict \(50t\) margin and arbitrary unknown cell masses, the evaluable sample-split procedure has risk and honest-length upper orders \(\min\{1,(d/n)^{2/3}\}\) and \(\min\{1,(d/n)^{1/3}\}\). Exact barycentric normalization now permits a degree of order \(\sqrt{\log(d)}\), proving matching powers on the lower side up to \(\exp\{C\sqrt{\log(ed)}\}\): the risk lower bound is \(\exp\{-C\sqrt{\log(e(d-1))}\}\min\{1,((d-1)/n)^{2/3}\}\), with the analogous cube-root honest-length bound. The exact growing-alphabet frontier and a pilot/factorial estimator attaining it remain open; fixed alphabets still have exact orders \(n^{-2/3}\) and \(n^{-1/3}\). A prespecified categorical analysis such as a conditional reanalysis of the randomized \(65\) Trial requires a scientific defense of the margin.
gap: MunchGerds2026 now studies the same scalar sublevel probability, but in a smooth-covariate local asymptotic model; BonviniKennedyKeele2023 studies the level set itself; neither determines a uniform finite-sample \(n,d\) frontier or honest scalar-interval length under arbitrary categorical masses. Existing discrete-functional methods do not preserve causal arm ratios, unknown propensities, exact normalization, and a supportwise CATE margin simultaneously.
fill: A single explicit \(F(n,d)\) will be matched by an evaluable pilot-local Jackson--factorial estimator, an honest connected interval of length \(\sqrt{F(n,d)}\), and all-procedure lower priors satisfying every causal and margin restriction in every support law.
